rationale: SBGI gapped up strongly (+3.48%) on a beat earnings report but has since reversed sharply from the session high of $15.98 down to $14.44, now sitting at just 13% of today's range and below VWAP ($14.98) and the 9-EMA ($14.46). The price action shows continued selling pressure in the last five candles with lower highs and lower lows, but the broader market is in a significant risk-off session (SPY -2.92%, VIXY +17.98%), making directional conviction difficult — a short faces the risk of a mean-reversion bounce near today's low ($14.20), while a long faces the headwind of a deteriorating market and price trading well below VWAP. The risk/reward is unclear enough to warrant standing aside.
